decisions.summary: Pacific Star changes free time for reefer containers at Busan to 5 days for reefer containers handled from 1 July 2026 onward.
Jiwoo Han hands over responsibility for updating the SOP-03 free-time table for Pacific Star's new 5-day reefer free time to Daniel Cho, as Jiwoo is leaving on 30 June.

tasks.summary: Update the SOP-03 free-time table to reflect Pacific Star's new reefer free time of 5 days from 1 July 2026.

deadlines.what: Due date for updating the SOP-03 free-time table with Pacific Star's 5-day reefer free time.
